    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE

        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'

        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'

    COUNT(*) AS total_loans
FROM 
    loan
JOIN 
    account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END;

sql:
SELECT 
    district.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_loans
FROM 
    loan
JOIN 
    account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END;

sql:
SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

    client_id,

        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,

    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,

        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,

                client c

                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

        client_id,

            SELECT

    )
)

)

SELECT 
    client_id,

    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,

    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,

            SELECT 
                c.client_id,

                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

)

sql:
SELECT 
    district.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
FROM 
    loan
JOIN 
    account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
    AND loan.status = 'C'
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END;

SELECT 
    client_id,

    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region;

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            c.client_id,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
            d.A11 AS average_salary
        FROM 
            client c
        JOIN 
            district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
        WHERE 
            c.gender = 'F'
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        (SUM(loans_with_no_issues) * 100.0 / SUM(total_loans)) AS overall_avg_percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues ON total_loans.region = loans_with_no_issues.region
    AND total_loans.loan_size_category = loans_with_no_issues.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
    o.overall_avg_percentage
FROM 
    total_loans t
JOIN 
    loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region
    AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_avg o;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS total_loans_table
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS no_issues_loans_table
ON 
    total_loans_table.region = no_issues_loans_table.region
    AND total_loans_table.loan_size_category = no_issues_loans_table.loan_size_category;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,

)

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

        Patient.ID, 
        Laboratory.UA, 
        Patient.SEX,
        Laboratory.Date AS LabDate

        Patient
    JOIN

sql:
SELECT 
    t1.region,
    t1.loan_size_category,
    t1.total_loans,
    t2.loans_with_no_issues,
    (t2.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t1.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS t1
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS t2
ON t1.region = t2.region AND t1.loan_size_category = t2.loan_size_category;

        Patient

)

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)

    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region)
ORDER BY 
    region;

        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000

        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'

    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,

   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009) AS total;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC NULLS LAST, 2 ASC NULLS LAST, 3 ASC NULLS LAST, 4 ASC NULLS LAST;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
  (completed_races * 100.0 / total_japanese_drivers) AS completion_percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT result.driverId) AS completed_races
   FROM results AS result
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   JOIN drivers AS driver ON result.driverId = driver.driverId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
   AND result.time IS NOT NULL) AS completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver.driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
   FROM drivers AS driver
   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009) AS total;

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver.driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
   FROM drivers AS driver
   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_with_no_issues) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        (t2.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t1.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS t1
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS t2
     ON t1.region = t2.region AND t1.loan_size_category = t2.loan_size_category);

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage

SELECT

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
    FROM 
        percentage
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC NULLS LAST, 2 ASC NULLS LAST, 3 ASC NULLS LAST, 4 ASC NULLS LAST;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) t
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) l
ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    t.region, t.loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) t
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) l
ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    t.region, t.loan_size_category;

FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT result.driverId) AS completed_races

   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId

   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009) AS total;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) t
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) l
ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    t.region, t.loan_size_category;

SELECT 
  (completed_races * 100.0 / total_japanese_drivers) AS completion_percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT result.driverId) AS completed_races
   FROM results AS result
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId

   FROM drivers AS driver
   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId

   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009) AS total;

SELECT 
    AVG(percentage_with_no_issues) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS total_loans_table
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS no_issues_loans_table

        total_loans_table.region = no_issues_loans_table.region
        AND total_loans_table.loan_size_category = no_issues_loans_table.loan_size_category);

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
