sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC NULLS LAST, 2 ASC NULLS LAST, 3 ASC NULLS LAST, 4 ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

    t1.loans_with_no_issues,
    t1.percentage_with_no_issues,
    67.43895503381427 AS overall_average_percentage,
    (t1.percentage_with_no_issues - 67.43895503381427) AS difference_from_average
FROM

        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'

        END AS loan_size_category,

        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

        loan.amount < 100000

        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS t1

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) t
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) l
ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    t.region, t.loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) t
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) l
ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
ORDER BY 
    t.region, t.loan_size_category;

FROM 
    (SELECT

        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) t
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues

        loan

        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id

        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

    t.region,
    t.loan_size_category,
    (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) t
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

        loan.amount < 100000

        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'

            ELSE 'Large'
        END) l

SELECT 
    total_loans_table.region,
    total_loans_table.loan_size_category,
    (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
    (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans - 67.43895503381425) AS difference_from_average
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS total_loans_table
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS no_issues_loans_table

    total_loans_table.region = no_issues_loans_table.region
    AND total_loans_table.loan_size_category = no_issues_loans_table.loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

SELECT 
    district.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM 
    loan
JOIN 
    account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END
ORDER BY 
    district.A2, loan_size_category;

    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS molecules_with_fluorine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN bond_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_bonds_with_fluorine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS molecules_without_fluorine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN bond_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_bonds_without_fluorine
FROM (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM molecule
    JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
) AS subquery

JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id;

        (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans - 67.43895503381425) AS difference_from_average
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS total_loans_table
     JOIN 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues

            loan
         JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS molecules_with_fluorine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN bond_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_bonds_with_fluorine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS molecules_without_fluorine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN bond_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_bonds_without_fluorine
FROM (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM molecule
    JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
) AS subquery
JOIN molecule ON subquery.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id;

        TotalEnrollment

        SELECT

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;

sql:
WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
fluorine_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN molecule.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_without_fluorine
    FROM molecule
    INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
),
bond_strength AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        AVG(CASE 
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (
    SELECT 
        molecule.molecule_id,
        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    (carcinogenic_without_fluorine * 100.0 / total_carcinogenic_molecules) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(num_atoms) AS avg_atoms_per_molecule,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element != 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN num_bonds ELSE 0 END) AS avg_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules
JOIN fluorine_analysis ON TRUE
JOIN avg_bonds ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = avg_bonds.molecule_id
JOIN bond_strength ON carcinogenic_molecules.molecule_id = bond_strength.molecule_id;

SELECT 
    district.A2 AS region,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END AS loan_size_category,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM 
    loan
JOIN 
    account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    loan.amount < 100000
GROUP BY 
    district.A2,
    CASE 
        WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Large'
    END
ORDER BY 
    district.A2, loan_size_category;
